en: The Opinion Bits each began to give off light once more and started exchanging auras.{w}{p}Before long, the Opinion Bits all turned toward Zaalhaut at once.{w}
"..........{w}...We have reached the conclusion that we are unable to answer."{w}{p}"We will set this topic aside. Please enlighten us as to the correct answer."{w}
note: Echoes row 1662 ("unable to understand" there, "unable to answer" here). Second page reused verbatim in row 1676.

en: "It's hair."{w}
note: Answer to the riddle in row 1666 (the longer it grows, the closer it gets to the ground).

en: "...I see. Understood.{w}Now then, your elimination..."{w}
"What is it... that has endless faces?"{w}
note: Riddle; Zaalhaut's answer in row 1677 is "a name".

en: Just as before, the Opinion Bits began exchanging auras.{w}

"These things have a habit of insisting on recognizing exactly where a conversation starts and ends."{w}{p}"So the more I keep them puzzling, the more time I can buy.{w}...Now go, quickly, while you have the chance."{w}{p}"Don't worry about me.{w}I haven't lived such a feeble life that I need brats worrying about me."{w}{p}"Leave this to me, and hurry to the Coronation Hall."{w}
note: "Coronation Chamber" for [JP] (new term). [JP] -> "brats" (Zaalhaut's gruff voice, [JP]).

en: The question-and-answer session between Zaalhaut and the Opinion Bits goes on and on.{w}
"We will set this topic aside. Please enlighten us as to the correct answer."{w}
note: Identical to the second page of row 1669; kept word for word.

en: "A name."{w}
"That which is truly equal, that which walks on without ever looking back, that which is carved by a great sword and a small sword...{w}Do you know what it is?"{w}
note: Riddle for "time" (clock hands = great/small sword). Phrases are quoted back in rows 1688 and 1692, kept matching.

en: "...That would be light."{w}
"Hm?{w}What's this, you've decided to answer after all?{w}Too bad, though. The answer is 'time.'"{w}
"No. No such thing exists."{w}
"It is light."{w}
"The flow of time is the same for each and every thing there is, surely."{w}
"No, it is light.{w}That which falls equally upon all things -- that is light."{w}
"...I'm telling you, it's time."{w}
"There is no such thing as time.{w}It is light."{w}
".........."{w}{p}"...Then what about the clue 'that which walks on without ever looking back'?"{w}

"It is light."{w}{p}"Light -- that is to say, the great Elnoa-Malem -- is the one who will abolish such foolish pacts of the past as the Phase Shift, and bring stability to the future of the Real Axis."{w}
note: [JP] -> "the great Elnoa-Malem" ([JP] rendered without Lord/Lady: gender unknown). [JP] = "Phase Shift" (as in chap slice_007 / wmap slice_19). [JP] -> "the True Axis": coined, meaning unclear (real + pivot + foundation) - flag.

en: "El... noa...? Malem, you say?"{w}
"We have answered your question. This conversation is over.{w}Now then, your elimination..."{w}
"W-Wait!{w}Then what about 'carved by a great sword and a small sword'!?"{w}{p}"That's supposed to mean the hands of a clock! You can't explain that, can you!?"{w}

"Why, light, naturally."{w}{p}"The lesser sin of you all defying us, the greater sin of failing to fulfill your duty of bringing forth the Eld..."{w}{p}"Those two swords, the lesser sin and the greater, wound the heart of the great Elnoa-Malem."{w}
note: [JP] = "the Eld" (wmap slice_19). [JP] read as "you (mortals) all", the Bit addressing Zaalhaut's kind generally.

en: "Wh... what are... you... saying..."{w}

"We have answered your question. This conversation is over.{w}Now then, let us carry out your elimination."{w}{p}"Those who set foot in the Sanctum of Genesis are fated to be judged by the Opinion of Light and the Opinion Bits."{w}
note: [JP] -> "Sanctum of Creation" (new term). [JP] -> "the Opinion of Light" (new term). First sentence kept identical to row 1691.

en: "The Opinion of Light...!?"{w}

note: Naru = god of time per wmap slice_16. [JP] -> "the power over time"; [JP] -> "divine protection"; [JP] -> "a god of light". [JP] -> "Shebe" (new name, nature unknown: a place or people that fell).

en: "...You who know too much.{w}Be burned by the holy light, and vanish."{w}
"Ha, just try it, you heartless lackeys!"{w}

"It is futile.{w}Even if one or two of us should fall, we will appear again in any number."{w}{p}"You never had a chance to begin with.{w}If you step aside, we will at least let you pass on without suffering. What will you do?"{w}
note: [JP] read as "if you clear the way" (stop blocking the Bits from pursuing the party).

en:
"No chance, you say?{w}Heh, you really do look down on me.
...This is a waste of time. Come at me, all of you at once."{w}
(Those kids will perform the rite of re-coronation and come back alive.{w}Buying them the time for that is all I need.){w}
note: Inner thought. [JP] -> "those kids" (Zaalhaut calls the party [JP] in row 1674). [JP] -> "rite of re-coronation" (new term).

en: "I am Zaalhaut, the child the wicked mage Zanu left behind.{w}
note: Opening quote left unclosed as in source; row 1704 re-shows this text in {0E}..{0F}. [JP] -> "Zanu" (new name). [JP] = child left behind by a dead parent.

en:
{0E}"I am Zaalhaut, the child the wicked mage Zanu left behind.{0F}
The cursed child that lust and a spirit's tears brought into this world!"{w}
note: Highlighted part matches row 1703 word for word.

en: "Let's see how long mere servants of a god can stand against this unblessed power of mine!"{w}
note: Source has a typo ([JP] for [JP]).

en: Opinion Bit
note: Name box, 17 chars (slightly over ~16). Fallback if too wide: "Op. Bit Voice". Several Bits speak in row 1707; Zaalhaut is down and only hears them.
Exchange between several Opinion Bits. [JP] -> "Ryug" (wmap slice_20). [JP] -> "this one" (no pronoun for Zaalhaut). 2[JP] literally "only two"; "possibilities" added for the noun.

en: The Opinion Bits left.{w}

"So... I couldn't win after all...{w}In the end... all I can do...
is dance in the palm of a god's hand...?"{w}{p}"I can't hear anymore. My eyes are going dim.{w}I wonder if those kids pulled it off..."{w}
"The land where I was born... my precious place...{w}This... cursed body of mine...{w}the only... thing that ever... ac... cepted it..."{w}{p}"Mo... th... er...{w}I'm sor... ..."{w}
note: Dying line; Zaalhaut switches from [JP] to [JP] (no English equivalent). Order of the broken fragments kept across the {w}s. [JP] -> "Mother"; [JP]… -> "I'm sor..." (gomen). [JP] read as the land accepting the cursed body.

en: Spirits gather around Zaalhaut.{w}Lifting up the body, they carried it all the way to the exit.{w}
Strange Being
note: [JP] = the unnamed figure before it introduces itself as Spectoria (row 1715).

en: "So you have come this far after all."{w}
"I am Spectoria. Executor of the Divine Realm."{w}
note: Spectoria / Divine Realm as in wmap slice_19. [JP] -> "Executor" (wmap uses Executor for [JP] Branon).

en: You feel an overwhelming presence from the one called Spectoria, unlike anything you have felt before.{w}There is nowhere for you to run.{w}
note: No pronoun for Spectoria (gender not in glossary).

en: "Ordinarily, the likes of you would be nothing more than a trifling matter."{w}{p}"But you have gone too far.{w}Anything more would go against the divine will."{w}{p}"You will now receive your punishment. Prepare yourselves."{w}

"I see you are worthy of having made it all the way here."{w}{p}"It cannot be helped.{w}This time, and this time only, I shall withdraw."{w}{p}"But do not forget that you are always in the palm of our hand..."{w}

Spectoria vanished into the light.{w}{p}Having defeated the Qualia, you raised all the Ranks you had obtained toward the sky in the center of the room.{w}They then turned into the shining [Sun's Light Rank].{w}
note: [JP] -> "Qualia" (new term; guardians of the Sanctum, see row 1643). [JP] -> "Ranks", [JP] -> "Radiant Rank of the Sun" (new key item name, must match ITEM_PRIZ when that CSV is translated). [JP] -> [ ].

en:
[Key Item]
Obtained Sun's Light Rank.{w}
note: Key-item format as chap slice_001.

Flee: Yes, Treasure: Yes, Rematch: No, Friendly: Yes{w}

en: An unfamiliar adventurer appeared before you.{w}

note: Runtime insert only; nothing to translate.
Runtime insert only; nothing to translate.

en: There is a giant doll.{w}{p}When the doll spots you, it breaks into a big smile, as if it had found a new toy, and slowly reaches out its hands toward you.{w}{p}If a game of dolls is about to begin, it is you who will be playing the dolls.{w}
You picked up an item.{w}
note: Used in 30 places.

en: You see that 'Night' has appeared ahead of you.{w}Before long, the 'Night' takes human form and overwhelms everything around it with its sheer presence.{w}
Is that gentlemanly bearing a sign of how sure it is of itself?{w}The one who reigns at the summit of the Kin of Night unhurriedly invites you to a ball of death.{w}
note: [JP] -> "the kin of night" (patterned on "kin of darkness", chap slice_008 / wmap slice_20). No pronoun for the figure.

en: A strange sight is unfolding before your eyes.{w}{p}Darkness and darkness, cancelling each other out, are shrinking again and again.{w}{p}The darkness on your side gradually weakens and begins to be swallowed by new darkness seeping out.{w}
You stand face to face with one who has crossed over from another world.{w}Can you protect this world?{w}

You have come upon a dreamlike revel.{w}{p}Beautifully shining wings light up the surroundings like a full moon.{w}Perhaps rejoicing at the appearance of their lord, wrapped in phosphorescent light, insects of every kind are drunk on this revel of light.{w}{p}But there is just one unfortunate thing.{w}It seems no place has been set for you in this dreamlike scene.{w}
Even when you try to look, you cannot look away.{w}Even when you try to flee, you cannot fight.{w}Even when you want to die, you cannot survive.{w}{p}That is our Brain Through.{w}
note: Deliberately paradoxical/garbled verse, kept as is. [JP] -> "Brain Through" (new name; boss/encounter name, likely a pun). [JP] -> "our" (speaker unknown).

en: Suddenly, thunderclouds gather all around.{w}Each time lightning flashes, the shadow of some unknown beast is cast upon the sky.{w}
You witness the appearance of a fearsome monster.{w}

A strange sensation of space twisting.{w}Something that must never appear seems to have crossed the line and appeared.{w}{p}Will your bodies, too, be taken over like those of the victims before you?{w}
Azabas
note: New name (romanized).

en:
"What, you lot were wandering around a place like this?{w}Look at the power that's taken root in my body!"{w}{p}"I'm the Demon Duke now!
Nobody's ever going to give me lip again.{w}...Not even that bastard Fendel!!"{w}{p}"Come, scorching winds of destruction! Come to me!"{w}{p}"Let's teach them all that I'm the one who rules everything!
The Wastelands, the New Lands, the Dark Realm, the Divine Realm --
we'll teach every last one of them!!"{w}
note: [JP] -> "Demon Archduke" (new term; also used by the Ryug in SCD16). [JP] -> "Fendel" (new name). [JP] "Wastelands" (wmap: declared a wasteland), [JP] "New Lands" (new term), [JP] "Dark Realm", [JP] "Divine Realm" as in wmap. [JP]: Azabas rallies himself/the winds; rendered "let's".

en: "Damn iiiiit!{w}Why am I losiiiiing!?!"{w}{p}"I...!{w}was supposed to have gotten... power that loses to no one...!{w}Wasn't I...!?"{w}{p}"It's still... not enough...?"{w}

A scorching tornado swallowed Azabas from the feet up.
It was so fierce that you shut your eyes without thinking.{w}
When you next came to your senses, there was nothing there.{w}
The sound of something being dragged, scrape, scrape, draws gradually closer.{w}
A bizarre form was there, impossible to tell whether dragon or fish.{w}{p}It gave a shudder and let out a hair-raising roar.{w}It was the signal that mealtime had come.{w}
CLICK, CLACK, GO SOME CRISP, BRISK FOOTSTEPS.{w}IN TIME WITH THEM, A HIGH LAUGH RINGS OUT.{w}
note: Source is all-kana with spaced dakuten (retro 8-bit text parody, continued in slice_022 rows 1749-1752). Rendered in ALL CAPS as the English equivalent of old-console text; slice_022 should match. [JP] = loud/haughty laugh.
